author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Why are laptops getting so expensive? Learn how the AI boom is putting pressure on RAM and SSD prices, why chipmakers can't quickly increase supply, and what it means for your next computer. We'll look at Apple's MacBook Air price increases, how a laptop can become a worse deal without its price changing, and what to check before deciding whether to buy now or wait.

Host: Kevin Stratvert
